chapter_seo_title: RMJI Chapter 334 – The Baleful Pill: A Devil’s Bargain for Core Formation
chapter_meta_description: Han Li scores the legendary Blood Coagulation Five Elements Pills, but the secret art behind them comes with a terrifying price: a one-in-three chance at a golden core—that will slowly rot your mind.
og_title: A One-in-Three Chance at Immortality… That Eats Your Brain
og_description: Han Li discovers the Baleful Pill Art: a shortcut to Core Formation that permanently dulls your wits. In the Mortal Stream, even the best loot is a trap.
twitter_title: The Baleful Pill – RMJI Serves Up Its Cruelest Shortcut Yet
twitter_description: A pseudo-golden core with a 1-in-3 success rate, but it caps your growth and erodes your mind. Classic chicken-rib dilemma in the Mortal Stream.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare pill refined from demonic arts, capable of granting a pseudo-golden core to Foundation Establishment cultivators; provides a one-in-three chance at Core Formation but comes with severe, permanent side effects.
A man-made golden core formed through the Baleful Pill Art; it is fixed at early Core Formation and continuously leaks baleful energy that dulls the cultivator's mind over time.

A classical Chinese idiom describing something that is tempting to have but impossible to use effectively; in xianxia, it signals a resource that is valuable in theory but useless or dangerous in practice.
A legendary demonic secret art that allows a cultivator to refine a second, independent body; one of the highest secrets of demonic sects, rarely obtained by orthodox cultivators.
A rare, dark magical tool that traps and stores souls and primordial spirits, gradually dissolving their spiritual nature into ordinary wandering ghosts for heretical commands.
A solidified, crimson projectile formed from the user's condensed blood energy; when recovered, it can be repurposed as a magical tool.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn’t Han Li just take the Baleful Pill shortcut?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The pill caps cultivation at early Core Formation and slowly erodes the user’s intelligence—Han Li’s sharp wits are his greatest survival asset, so the trade-off is unacceptable.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the External Incarnation technique mentioned here?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is a top-tier demonic secret art that lets a cultivator refine a second body, which can be used to house a separate cultivation path—perfect for offloading the Baleful Pill’s drawbacks.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the “chicken rib” metaphor in this chapter?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It refers to the Blood Coagulation Five Elements Pills—too valuable to discard, but too dangerous to use directly on himself, leaving Han Li searching for an alternative application.
